Name: Prismatic Clothing
Author: Atravita
TagLine: Lets you use the prismatic shard to dye clothing prismatic colors.
Description:
This mod lets you dye dyable clothing prismatic with the prismatic shard.

Install

1.  Install the latest version of [SMAPI](https://smapi.io).

2.  Download and install [AtraCore](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12932).

3.  Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].

4.  Run the game using SMAPI.
Compatibility

*   Works with Stardew Valley 1.5.6 on Linux/macOS/Windows.

*   Works in single player, multiplayer, and split-screen mode.

*   Should be compatible with most other mods.
See also

*   [Changelog](https://github.com/atravita-mods/StardewMods/blob/main/PrismaticClothing/docs/Changelog.md)

*   [Source](https://github.com/atravita-mods/StardewMods/blob/main/PrismaticClothing)
All donation points for this mod go to [Against Malaria](https://www.againstmalaria.com/). Please consider supporting them if you like this mod!
